title: 3.3.0-beta1 Combo pump pair screen fails to load Android 15
body:
Started losing connection to the pump after updating Android today to v15. Attempted to unpair/re-pair but upon opening pair window, nothing loads.

I will note that Android complains that the app has been "built for an older version of Android" when I attempt to toggle the permission. 

Logs attached, combo logging seems to start around 22:59:49

build version: 9209de1dd0-2024.12.18
